title: Do not retain original source annotations as app context
decision: SG-0007 should not retain development-only original source annotations as app-facing extracted context. Files and fields under workspaces/epp-full/extracts/source-annotations that represent original office/catalog source files should be removed or normalized so original file names, source_path fields, and source-file semantics are not exposed. Retained regulatory extracted context may remain when it supports CFR or Survey Guidance views.
context: A repo scan showed workspaces/epp-full/extracts/source-annotations contains annotation files named after original .docx/.xls/.xlsx sources, with source_path fields inside. This would reintroduce the development-only source-file layer even after removing source-files and sanitizing catalog/project metadata.
rationale: Extracted context can be app-facing data. Removing or normalizing development-only original source annotations keeps the retention boundary consistent while preserving regulatory context that the app actually uses.
alternatives_considered: Keep all source annotations as extracted context
Retain source annotation filenames but strip source_path fields
Remove all extracted context, including retained regulatory context
consequences: SG-0007 must clean or omit development-only original source annotations during import refresh
The source-leak check should include app-facing extracted context, while still excluding canonical Markdown document bodies
Retained regulatory extracted context remains allowed where it supports CFR and Survey Guidance
SG-0013 should not read or expose original source annotations as document/source metadata
